prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-15.7% and -8.9%).
Adding new flows during adoption (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests (-13.3%, -0.9%, and -4.5%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 8 of 12 tests, despite 3 winning tests (+6.4%, +3.6%, and +2.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced inconsistent results, ranging from strong wins to severe losses.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose path step using a split view layout that presents ready companions versus custom photo pet paths side-by-side. (why: Choose path has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating users struggle to evaluate the difference between ready pets and photo generation.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Later In Journey Reorder: Reorder the onboarding flow so sign-in occurs after pet adoption certificate confirmation, right before generation waiting. (why: Moving sign-in after pet adoption lets users bond with their pet selection first while ensuring cloud account saving occurs right before generation.)
2: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Path Preference Intro Screen: Add a new introductory preview screen before path selection that introduces the two adoption paths with visual card highlights. (why: Mean time on choose_path is over 8 minutes (514s); a dedicated visual intro screen clarifies options before making a selection.)
3: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Checklist Layout Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen to a checklist layout detailing account cloud sync, pet recovery protection, and multi-device access. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after re-signing in; highlighting account sync benefits directly on sign-in builds trust.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Instant Adoption Headline: Update the headline and body text on choose_path to emphasize instant adoption readiness vs custom photo generation. (why: The mean time on choose_path is 514s; clear headline distinctions help users decide quickly.)
5: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Two Column Grid Layout: Change the layout of pick_friend screen to a structured two-column layout with clear companion pet previews. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 78.8% with median time 89s; organizing choices into side-by-side comparison helps users pick faster.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Launch Notification Visual: Update the waiting screen to include a progress component and notification hint to inform users when desktop docking is complete. (why: Home step median time is 201s with 90.3% completion; users wait long for desktop rendering and 3 support emails reported pet not displaying on desktop.)
7: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Checklist Stage Redesign: Redesign home_intro with a checklist layout outlining key controls (drag, hide, interact) for the new desktop pet. (why: 3 support emails asked how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding, and finish step conversion drops to 75.5%.)
8: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Spotlight Layout: Update adoption_certificate screen layout to spotlight view highlighting official pet companion adoption. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 78.8%; spotlighting the adoption certificate creates a clear milestone completion moment.)

Adding new screens consistently harms conversion performance across past tests.
